Compute.description: The CPU and memory a task asks for. Only what is given is kept, the defaults are the task namespace's.

requests.description: What the task is guaranteed. A request without a limit of its own can't be over the default limit (chart value taskCompute.default.limits)

limits.description: What the task can't go over. A limit can't be lower than its request, and no value in compute can be over the node max (chart value taskCompute.max)

Compute.title: Compute

ComputeQuantities.description: CPU and memory, as Kubernetes quantities.

cpu.description: CPU in cores or millicores, e.g. 2, 0.5 or 500m
cpu.title: Cpu

memory.description: Memory as a whole number with an optional unit, e.g. 512Mi, 4Gi or 2e9
memory.title: Memory

ComputeQuantities.title: ComputeQuantities

PrSpec.description: What a client may set in the `spec` of a pull request spec file.

image.description: The container image the task runs
image.title: Image

dataset.description: The name of a dataset the project is assigned and has active. Without it the project's default dataset is used, if it has one
dataset.title: Dataset

env.description: Environment variables of the task. A name has to match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, and can't be ARTIFACT_PATH, CDM_SCHEMA, CONFIG_PATH, CONNECTION_STRING, DB_PASSWORD, DB_USERNAME, WRITE_SCHEMA or start with DAGSTER_ or KUBERNETES_, in any letter case. The env as JSON is at most 32768 bytes
env.title: Env

tags.description: Tags copied onto the task's run. A key has to match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,63}$, a value is text
tags.title: Tags

config.description: A JSON object the task reads as a file, at the path in its CONFIG_PATH env. Contents are not checked
config.title: Config

compute.description: The CPU and memory the task asks for. Without it the defaults apply

PrSpec.title: PrSpec

description: A pull request spec file: a JSON object with a `spec` and, optionally, a `metadata`.

metadata.description: The client's own: any JSON value, not validated, kept with the task and delivered with the results. The whole spec file is at most 65536 bytes
metadata.title: Metadata

title: PrSpecFile
